recommendation: Keep this source correction. It preserves the approved no-cardinality-change approach and prevents implementers from interpreting an Expression-only extension as applicable to Reference(Group) elements; any Quality Measure or SANER profile-specific work belongs in those IGs.
issue_request: FHIR-42712 asked to increase Measure.group.population.criteria from 0..1 to 0..* so multiple equivalent expression formats could be supplied. The Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept cardinalities unchanged and directed core to mention cqf-alternativeExpression on Measure expression-valued elements instead.
initial_application: Commit 8bae5aee21a8aa28c28e7bdcca4f7a5f42974fdd, referenced from the Jira comment via HL7/fhir#3423, applied the requested Measure comments. It correctly updated Expression-valued criteria elements, but also appended the same sentence to Measure.group.stratifier.groupDefinition and Measure.group.stratifier.component.groupDefinition, which are Reference(Group) elements.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists measure=Measure as an active current-build resource. The cqf-alternativeExpression definition in the FHIR Extension Pack has context Expression, confirming that the guidance should not be attached to Reference(Group) comments. FHIR-29815 is the prior published core decision choosing cqf-alternativeExpression over repeated criteria elements; FHIR-42907 and FHIR-42711 are external IG follow-ups/background.
reconciliation: Changed source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml to remove the cqf-alternativeExpression sentence from the two groupDefinition comments. Left the comments on Measure.group.population.criteria, Measure.group.stratifier.criteria, Measure.group.stratifier.component.criteria, and Measure.supplementalData.criteria.
source_changes: source/measure/structuredefinition-Measure.xml: removed cqf-alternativeExpression wording from Measure.group.stratifier.groupDefinition and Measure.group.stratifier.component.groupDefinition comments.
